read.thesis: Record $1.1B quarter and backlog over $6B, with FY27 revenue raised to $4.2–4.45B, but H2 margins guided down to high-20s gross and high-teens EBITDA on logistics and diesel inflation.

capex.quote: Over the next 12 months, we expect to invest approximately $40 million of CapEx to build out our U.S. manufacturing plant

triggers.label: FY27 revenue raised to $4.2–4.45B
triggers.quote: We expect revenue of $4.2 billion to $4.45 billion, adjusted EBITDA of $890 million to $940 million

triggers.label: H2 margins guided down on logistics
triggers.quote: Adjusted gross margins expected in the high 20s and adjusted EBITDA margins in the high teens

triggers.label: Backlog over $6B, record
triggers.quote: growing our backlog to over $6 billion

triggers.label: Q3 revenue up ~10% YoY, sequentially down
triggers.quote: Q3 revenue down sequentially from our record Q2, but up approximately 10% year-over-year

guidance.quote: We expect revenue of $4.2 billion to $4.45 billion
adjusted EBITDA of $890 million to $940 million
adjusted diluted EPS of $4.61 to $4.87 per share
increasing our free cash flow estimates from $450 million to over $500 million
adjusted gross margin and adjusted EBITDA margin to be in the high 20s and high teens, respectively
achieve over 10 gigawatts of capacity by the end of calendar '27
